title: Vibrant Sour American Pork Shoulder Skillet
description: A sour and tender American dish featuring pork shoulder steaks, perfect for a weeknight dinner, with a lacto-vegetarian friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sour cream, apple cider vinegar, honey, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork shoulder slices to the bowl and coat with the marinade.
Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork slices for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top the pork with chopped fresh parsley.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
